specification.objective: Run a reversible diagnostic isolation of the project Kanban subtree to test whether constructing KanbanBoardView inside the project/tasks workspace is the causal trigger for the observed web ghosting on wide viewports and missing content on narrow responsive viewports. This change is diagnostic and must not remove Kanban domain, API, persistence, or controller behavior.

requirements.statement: ProjectTasksPage must continue rendering projects, project access, tasks, task membership, and all non-Kanban workspace sections unchanged.
When a project is selected, ProjectTasksPage must not construct the Kanban workspace or KanbanBoardView during this diagnostic build.
Kanban backend, controller, contracts, services, widgets, imports, dialogs, and methods must remain present so the experiment is reversible and does not delete functionality.
The locked POLIS Change Contract must be versioned at docs/contracts/project-tasks-kanban-isolation-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The _buildContent widget tree no longer invokes _buildKanbanWorkspace while the rest of the selected-project workspace remains intact.
Frontend regression expectations explicitly assert that KanbanBoardView is absent from ProjectTasksPage during the isolation experiment.
No backend, API, database, authorization, controller, Kanban widget implementation, or renderer bootstrap file changes are part of this payload.
The locked schema-v4 contract is included under docs/contracts/project-tasks-kanban-isolation-v1.polis.json.

invariants.statement: Kanban data loading and backend behavior are not removed or migrated in this diagnostic slice.
Project/task CRUD, membership, permissions, responsive workspace shell, and navigation remain unchanged.
The isolation is reversible by restoring the two Kanban children in _buildContent.

forbidden_states.statement: The payload deletes Kanban models, services, API routes, controller methods, or widget implementation.
The diagnostic changes WorkspaceScaffold, BackdropFilter, renderer bootstrap, or browser-specific configuration.
ProjectTasksPage still constructs KanbanBoardView through _buildKanbanWorkspace from _buildContent.

inputs.statement: The project/tasks page with a selected project on wide and narrow Flutter Web viewports.

outputs.statement: A project/tasks workspace identical in non-Kanban behavior but with the Kanban subtree not constructed.
A controlled build suitable for comparing whether ghosting and narrow-viewport disappearance persist without Kanban.

failure_semantics.statement: If _buildContent still invokes _buildKanbanWorkspace or the diagnostic regression expectation is absent, validation fails closed with project_tasks_kanban_isolation_missing.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; s=Path('lib/features/projects/presentation/project_tasks_page.dart').read_text(); t=Path('test/features/projects/presentation/project_tasks_page_test.dart').read_text(); a=s.index('Widget _buildContent'); b=s.index('Widget _buildWorkspaceHeader'); body=s[a:b]; ok=('_buildKanbanWorkspace()' not in body and 'kanban workspace is isolated from project tasks rendering' in t and 'Widget _buildKanbanWorkspace()' in s); print('project_tasks_kanban_isolation_ok' if ok else 'project_tasks_kanban_isolation_missing'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
